topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Hey, I found this list in the back of your old journal. A bucket list, huh? I guess we never really talked about what you want to do. Skydiving, learning Spanish, visiting the northern lights—I’m so excited! We should totally find a way to make these happen, one by one. I mean, skydiving sounds terrifying, but if it means seeing that grin on your face, I’m in. And Spanish? I’ll be your practice buddy. Every weekend, we can cook some paella and practice our new words. This list is like a treasure map, and I can’t wait to explore it with you. Let’s do this!
